Build Tiny Pty Ltd is an innovative Australian manufacturer specialising in the design and construction of premium tiny homes and modular living solutions. Operating from its Campbellfield, VIC manufacturing facility, the company combines skilled craftsmanship, precision engineering and modern construction techniques to deliver high-quality, durable and sustainable homes for customers throughout Australia. 

Due to continued business growth, Build Tiny Pty Ltd is seeking an experienced and trade-qualified Welder (First Class) to join its production team.

Working within a modern manufacturing environment, you will fabricate and weld structural steel and metal components used in the construction of custom-built tiny homes. The successful applicant will be capable of working from engineering drawings, maintaining high quality standards and contributing to efficient production schedules.
This is a full-time position offering long-term career opportunities within a growing Australian manufacturer.

Minimum Requirements

-	Certificate III in Engineering – Fabrication Trade (or equivalent qualification) 
-	Minimum one-year relevant post-qualification experience as a Welder (First Class) 
-	Demonstrated experience in MIG and TIG welding and general steel fabrication 
-	Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and fabrication plans 
-	Strong understanding of fabrication tolerances and quality control procedures 
-	Commitment to workplace health and safety 

Key Responsibilities

-	Perform high-quality MIG, TIG and other welding processes on structural steel, stainless steel and aluminium components used in tiny home construction. 
-	Fabricate, assemble and weld chassis, structural frames, brackets and other metal components in accordance with engineering drawings and production specifications. 
-	Read and interpret technical drawings, welding symbols and fabrication documentation. 
-	Prepare materials by cutting, grinding, drilling, milling, tapping and shaping steel components prior to fabrication. 
-	Measure, mark and accurately align components using precision measuring equipment. 
-	Inspect welds to ensure structural integrity, penetration, dimensional accuracy and compliance with quality standards. 
-	Complete finishing work including grinding, dressing, polishing and deburring fabricated components. 
-	Assist in fitting fabricated steel assemblies into modular building frames where required. 
-	Operate welding and fabrication equipment safely and efficiently while ensuring machinery is maintained in good working condition. 
-	Identify fabrication issues and work collaboratively with supervisors and production staff to achieve practical manufacturing solutions. 
-	Maintain welding procedure specifications, quality assurance documentation and production records. 
-	Ensure compliance with workplace health, safety and environmental procedures. 
-	Contribute to achieving daily production targets while maintaining high standards of workmanship. 

To be successful you will possess

-	Demonstrated structural steel fabrication and welding experience within a manufacturing or engineering environment. 
-	Excellent fabrication, welding and metal finishing skills. 
-	Good mechanical aptitude and problem-solving skills. 
-	Ability to prioritise work and consistently meet production deadlines. 
-	Sound understanding of Australian workplace health and safety requirements. 
-	Physical fitness suitable for a manufacturing environment involving manual handling and standing for extended periods. 

If you meet the above criteria and are looking to join an innovative and growing Australian manufacturer, we would like to hear from you.

Please send your application to recruitment@targetbusiness.com.au

This role is accountable for establishing and maturing enterprise-wide information management practices, ensuring data is governed, structured, and leveraged as a strategic asset. You will lead the design and implementation of enterprise data models, governance frameworks, and information architecture, while acting as a senior data steward to ensure data quality, integrity, security, and compliance

You'll deliver this role by:

Define and enforce data ownership, stewardship, and accountability models across WMQ.

Lead governance forums and decision-making structures to prioritise and resolve data issues.

Act as the organisation's lead data steward, driving accountability for data quality and lifecycle management.

Define and maintain the enterprise information architecture and data models (conceptual, logical, and physical).

Establish standards for data structures, taxonomies, metadata, and master-reference data.

Partner with solution architects and delivery teams to ensure alignment between enterprise models and system implementations.

Drive data integration approaches and patterns across platforms and systems.

Establish frameworks for data quality management, profiling, and remediation.

Define and implement standards for data lifecycle management (creation, storage, usage, retention, and disposal).

Monitor data quality and risks, leading the identification and resolution of systemic data issues and improvement initiatives.

Enable improved decision-making through well-structured, trusted, and accessible data.

Partner with business and analytics teams to ensure data is fit-for-purpose for reporting, insights, and digital initiatives.

Identify opportunities to unlock value through better data utilisation, reuse, and standardisation.

Contribute to enterprise digital, data, and technology strategies.

What We Offer

Attractive Remuneration plus packaging benefits - Boost your take-home pay by up to $18,550 annually through not-for-profit tax concessions

Work-life balance - Enjoy flexible hours that work around your life, we promote a culture that values personal time and well-being

What We're Looking For

Tertiary qualifications in Information Management, Data, Information Technology or related discipline.

Demonstrated experience in data governance, information architecture, or enterprise data management in complex environments with multiple systems and data sources.

Strong understanding of data governance frameworks, policies, and controls.

Demonstrated experience improving data quality and integrity at scale, together with experience defining enterprise data models and standard

Strong stakeholder engagement and influencing capability across business and technical audiences.

High level analytical and problem-solving skills.

A Valuable Addition, Yet Not a Must-Have!

Experience with data governance tools or catalogues.

Understanding of data privacy, records management, and regulatory compliance frameworks.

Exposure to analytics, reporting, or data visualisation environments.

Essential Requirements

Proof of COVID-19 vaccination status (or as required by legislation and WMQ policy)

Relevant probity checks required by legislation and WMQ Limited policy.

Current Driver's Licence and willingness to travel for work
